values.en: The Affine Embedding and Points at Infinity

Geometric picture. The affine embedding $\iota(x,y)=[x:y:1]$ has image the piece $Z\neq 0$, with inverse $[X:Y:Z]\mapsto(X/Z,Y/Z)$. A line in $\mathbb{R}^3$ through the origin that is not contained in the plane $Z=0$ meets the plane $Z=1$ in exactly one point, which represents that class; the lines lying in $Z=0$ never meet $Z=1$ and correspond instead to points at infinity, one for every pencil of parallel lines of $\mathbb{R}^2$. Thus $\mathbb{P}^2_{\mathbb{R}}$ may be read as $\mathbb{R}^2$ together with one point at infinity for each pencil of parallel lines, which is the sense in which parallel lines meet at infinity.
values.zh-CN: 几何图景。仿射嵌入 $\iota(x,y)=[x:y:1]$ 的像为 $Z\neq 0$ 那一片，其逆为 $[X:Y:Z]\mapsto(X/Z,Y/Z)$。$\mathbb{R}^3$ 中过原点且不落在平面 $Z=0$ 内的直线与平面 $Z=1$ 恰交于一点，该点代表这个等价类；落在 $Z=0$ 内的直线则永不与 $Z=1$ 相交，它们对应无穷远点，$\mathbb{R}^2$ 中每一束平行直线对应一个这样的点。于是 $\mathbb{P}^2_{\mathbb{R}}$ 可读作 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 连同每条平行直线束的一个无穷远点，这正是「平行线交于无穷远」的含义。
